Definition: from the same as G3829; an innkeeper (warden of a caravanserai):--host.
BiblicalUsage: Pandocheus is the innkeeper, the host of the inn. The Samaritan gives the host two pence and says, Take care of him, and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the innkeeper is the quiet partner in the parable: mercy needs hands that stay and care after the hero has gone.
